key_insights: Why it matters: The changes redistribute leadership at Google’s central AI research organization while moving several prominent researchers outside the company.

What changed: Hassabis moved to Alphabet chief scientist, Kavukcuoglu took responsibility for DeepMind operations, and Jeff Dean, Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc Le reportedly departed to cofound Discovery Loop.
What to watch: Watch how the new leadership structure affects DeepMind’s research direction and how Discovery Loop defines its work on automating machine research.

cards.summary: Google announced its largest AI organization shakeup yet, moving Demis Hassabis into Alphabet’s chief scientist role and assigning DeepMind operations to Koray Kavukcuoglu. Multiple senior researchers also left to establish the autoresearch startup Discovery Loop.
cards.title: Google reshuffles AI leadership as senior DeepMind researchers leave
